item.title: 53 Years Later, The Greatest Closing Line In Sci-Fi History Is Still The Best Book Quote Of The 1970s
item.description: The canon of science-fiction literature is home to countless unforgettable endings, from 1984 ’s short but devastating retrospective ("He loved Big Brother") to The Three-Body Problem ’s defiant reminder that humanity cannot be so easily wiped out. The best sci-fi endings don't offer comfortable closure. Instead, they reframe everything that came before. In their closing lines, great sci-fi novelists leave readers suspended in the aftermath, forced to stew in the terrifying logic of cold technology, the fragility of human nature, and the vast expanse of space.

item.title: 10 Funniest 'Far Side' Comics About Cavemen and Their Early Innovations
item.description: Gary Larson’s comic strip The Far Side broke the mold of traditional newspaper comics by not having a recurring cast of characters. Peanuts had Charlie Brown, Snoopy, Linus and the rest of the gang. Garfield had Garfield, Odie, Jon, and some others. Calvin and Hobbes had Calvin, Hobbes, and Calvin’s parents. But The Far Side introduced new characters and scenarios every single day.

item.title: Controversial GTA 6 Easter Egg Will Annoy Millions of Gamers
item.description: Grand Theft Auto 6 is now out everywhere, and players are discovering just how much this game is filled to the brim with an overwhelming amount of things to do. In the game’s opening hours, you’ll land a place on the water, steal a car from a police impound, get into a car chase, and more. There are a million little things to do, like playing video games inside GTA 6 itself.

item.title: Valve Warns of a Possible Steam Machine Price Hike
item.description: Video game hardware manufacturers have been impacted by the computer component crisis , with Nintendo , PlayStation , and Xbox all raising the prices of their consoles this year. PC gaming giant Valve has increased the cost of its Steam Deck , and its PC-but-looks-like-a-console Steam Machine ended up being more expensive than Valve originally intended . Now, Valve has warned that its Steam Machine might get a price hike while opening up purchases for the cheapest model.

item.title: GTA 6 Gamble to Get Army Soldiers to Reenlist Actually Worked
item.description: With Grand Theft Auto 6 finally launching, some fans are booking time off work, while others are making considerably bigger commitments to secure a few uninterrupted days in Vice City. According to reporting from Task & Purpose , 43 soldiers from the U.S. Army's 9th Brigade Engineer Battalion at Fort Stewart, Georgia, have signed up for a special reenlistment incentive offering a four-day weekend to play GTA 6 when it launched on Nov. 19.

item.title: Steam Makes Strategy RPG Masterpiece Free For a Limited Time
item.description: Steam is giving PC strategy fans another opportunity to try a major grand strategy game without spending a cent. This week's promotion is particularly appealing for players who enjoy medieval history, political intrigue, and building a dynasty from the ground up.

item.title: GTA 6 Shows Why You Should Never, Ever, Ever Text and Drive (Ever)
item.description: You can pull off a lot of heinous crimes in Grand Theft Auto 6 . Stealing a car, mugging an old lady at gunpoint, killing a bird and then beating up a cop with its corpse. All of those are sure to earn you at least a one-star Wanted level. But there’s an even worse crime in GTA 6 that you’ll probably wind up doing more than murder: texting and driving.

item.title: Jordan Peele Might Be Bringing Back One of Horror’s Biggest Franchises
item.description: Jordan Peele has become one of the biggest names in modern horror, with his films Get Out , Us , and Nope helping establish him as one of the genre's most recognizable filmmakers. Through his production company, Monkeypaw Productions, Peele has also helped bring several other horror projects to the big screen, including Candyman , Monkey Man , and Him .

item.title: GTA 6 guides and walkthroughs
item.description: Grand Theft Auto 6 is finally here, and it's gigantic. The state of Leonida has a lot to explore, whether you want to go to nightclubs in Vice City or find a fishing hole in Key Lento.

item.title: Brandon Sanderson’s Mistborn TTRPG Solves the Biggest Problem With Licensed Games
item.description: Licensed tabletop role-playing games provide players with a new way to experience their favorite franchises like Star Wars , Star Trek, and the Lord of the Rings . But those adventures always come with a big question about how player characters are supposed to make their mark on stories that already have their own legendary heroes. Rather than erasing canon characters or turning them into quest-givers, the wildly ambitious Mistborn Legacy campaign for the Cosmere Roleplaying Game allows players to forge legends as powerful as any of Brandon Sanderson’s characters.
